name: Brumal-Fjard
description: A battered sphere of bare stone, cratered so densely that old impacts overlap like raindrops on a pond. Through it all runs a nearby asteroid belt, stark under a black sky.
No wind, no voice, no weather: the landscape communicates in light and shadow alone, and it has plenty to say at sunrise.
Around the signal of unknown origin, reality bends in small ways. Compasses sulk, clocks gain seconds, and long-stay crews develop identical tics.
Whoever controls silicon controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
